# Bloub attribution

Lappy includes the Bloub SVG animation engine by Jérémy Perret, pinned from
commit `b4bb3c1b5f93c7b87a2e8d620f667c4093d97749`.

- Source: https://github.com/jeremy-prt/bloub
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE` in this directory.
- Local adaptations: import paths, an English accessibility label, and an
  optional body-color override. The measured shapes, engine, expressions,
  morphing, gaze behavior, and timings remain in the upstream implementation.
